SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'error' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') as errors_last_hour,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') as success_last_hour,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'invite_sent' AND created_at > CURRENT_DATE) as invites_today,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'message_sent' AND created_at > CURRENT_DATE) as messages_today
FROM actions;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) as pending_sequences,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE scheduled_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND status = 'pending') as overdue_steps
FROM sequence_steps
WHERE status = 'pending';

UPDATE system_config SET value = 'sleeping', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE key = 'outreach_mode';

=INSERT INTO monitoring_logs (severity, metrics, alerts, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('analyze-health').item.json.severity }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('analyze-health').item.json.metrics) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('analyze-health').item.json.alerts) }}',
  NOW()
);
